request: Pull TLE elements for active satellites via the tle.ivanstanojevic.me API (Space-Track mirror). Extract satelliteId, name, epoch date, and TLE lines. Enrich with days_since_epoch and derive orbital classification-hint character from TLE line1. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 16 - Active Satellite TLE Catalog' on Tableau Server for space-domain-awareness analysts.

sources.name: Active Satellite TLE Catalog
sources.description: TLE (two-line element) API mirror of Space-Track: `/api/tle/?page=N&page-size=100`. Envelope: {@context, @id, @type, totalItems, member:[{@id, @type, satelliteId, name, date (ISO), line1, line2}], view:{first, next, last}}. Pagination via `page` param (1-based); ~25.5k active tracked satellites. Public, no auth. line1/line2 contain the standard NORAD TLE format (67 chars each); this flow keeps them as strings so consumers can propagate through SGP4 themselves.

args.name: TLE Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level calendar features parsed from `date` (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level TLE catalog entry.
args.stats_description: Long-form TLE-catalog statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month). Includes daily_count of updated element sets, 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies. Use to spot ephemeris-update campaigns and freshness gaps across the tracked population.

outputs.name: TLE Catalog Detail
outputs.description: Row-level active-satellite TLEs from the ivanstanojevic mirror (~2k rows first cut, up to 25.5k with more pages). Fields: satelliteId (NORAD Cat ID), name, date (ISO epoch), line1, line2 (standard 69-char NORAD TLE lines — feed to SGP4 for propagation), days_since_epoch (freshness). Plus calendar features. Source: tle.ivanstanojevic.me API. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: TLE Catalog Stats
outputs.description: Long-form TLE catalog trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month). Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify catalog-freshness distribution and update surges.
